attributes.description: massive, steep, snow-clad mountain peak with rugged, rocky face illuminated by low-angle sun, casting deep shadows and highlighting texture of ice and stone
flowing river or stream with long-exposure motion blur winds through snow-dusted rocks and pebbles
snow-dusted rocks and pebbles in the foreground
row of traditional, bright red wooden fishing cabins with white trim and snow-laden roofs, clustered together with some elevated on stilts, weathered wood and snow-capped roofs
fluffy and textured snow covering peaks, rocks, cabins, and the ground
sky transitions from warm golden-orange near the horizon to soft lavender and pale purple higher up, suggesting dawn or dusk
